messages.subject: Calderwood - draft letter of claim for review
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Draft letter of claim attached for your review. It follows the Pre-Action Protocol, sets out the 410 bar warranty and the delivery failures, references Richard's notice emails of 21 Aug, 9 Sep and 3 Oct 2024, and quantifies the loss at just over £3.8m. I've given them 21 days and flagged willingness to mediate.

If you're happy I'll finalise and send on our letterhead.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
